SELECT o.stocktake_id AS stocktakeId, o.stocktake_no AS stocktakeNo, o.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, o.stocktake_scope AS stocktakeScope, o.stocktake_type AS stocktakeType, o.stocktake_status AS stocktakeStatus, o.created_by AS createdBy, o.created_at AS createdAt,
COALESCE(diff.difference_item_count, 0) AS differenceItemCount, COALESCE(diff.difference_qty_total, 0) AS differenceQtyTotal,
a.adjustment_id AS adjustmentId, a.adjustment_no AS adjustmentNo, a.adjustment_status AS adjustmentStatus
FROM inv_stocktake_order o
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT stocktake_id, COUNT(*) AS difference_item_count, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(COALESCE(difference_qty, counted_qty - book_qty, 0))), 0) AS difference_qty_total FROM inv_stocktake_line WHERE COALESCE(difference_qty, counted_qty - book_qty, 0) != 0 GROUP BY stocktake_id ) diff ON diff.stocktake_id = o.stocktake_id
LEFT JOIN inv_adjustment_order a ON a.stocktake_id = o.stocktake_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND o.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND o.stocktake_status = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ( o.stocktake_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.stocktake_scope LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS draftCount,
0 AS pendingCount,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'COUNTING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS countingCount,
0 AS differencePendingCount,
0 AS adjustmentCreatedCount,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN stocktake_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS completedCount FROM inv_stocktake_order WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
